messages:
Elena García: Hi! I accepted the org invite from my phone and now I can see the org page but private repos show 404 when I try to clone. Anyone seen the GitHub mobile app do weird stuff with invites?
Tom Wright: Welcome Elena. Yep the mobile app sometimes doesn't surface the SAML SSO authorization step. If the account isn't SAML-authorized you'll get blocked from private repos.
Elena García: That sounds right. I clicked accept in the mobile app while logged into elena.personal but my invite was sent to elena@redwood.ai. Is that "wrong account" territory?
Sam Miller: If the invite went to your work email but you accepted with a different GH account then that personal account will be the one added (or the invite will be pending). We can revoke and re-send. First: can you paste the clone error?
Elena García: Terminal error when trying to clone via SSH: 
````
git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/secure-dash.git
Cloning into 'secure-dash'...
Permission denied (publickey).
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
````
I do have an SSH key set on my work account but maybe not on the personal one.
Tom Wright: That explains it. If your SSH key is on elena@redwood.ai but the repo access is tied to elena.personal then the key won't match. Two options: 1) we revoke accepted invite for elena.personal and resend to your work email, or 2) you add your SSH key to the account that accepted the invite.
Elena García: I prefer resend to work account. My phone auto-signed into personal account.
access-bot: Admin action: revoking pending invitation for github user elena.personal (requested by Sam Miller).
Sam Miller: Re-sent invite to elena@redwood.ai. When you accept, please open it in a desktop browser and confirm you click the SAML "Authorize" prompt. That will connect your account to the org identity provider.
Elena García: Accepted via desktop, clicked Authorize SAML, and I can now list the repo in the web UI. Doing `git clone` now... success! :tada:
Sam Miller: Added Elena to eng-platform team with write access. Quick reminder: make sure your SSH public key is on the same GH account that is a member; otherwise pushes will fail silently with permission errors.
Elena García: Confirmed SSH key is on elena@redwood.ai and push worked. Thanks all for the quick assist!
thread_body_preview: Accepted invite from mobile into personal account; SSH key/account mismatch; admin revoked and resent; accepted on desktop and authorized SAML; added to eng-platform; SSH fixed.
